BiblicalUsage: Abishur is named once, in 1 Chronicles 2:28, as a son of Shammai of the tribe of Judah: 'And the sons of Shammai were... Abishur, whose wife was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban and Molid.' He is one name in the genealogy of Judah, the tribe of the promise.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse in the genealogy of Judah, with a wife and two sons named beside him — and nothing more. I believe that is enough to matter: Abishur sits in the tribe that leads to David and to Christ, and the Bible does not lose the small names on the way to the great one.
